Disposition: `EXISTING CONTRACT FAMILIES SUFFICIENT / BOUNDED DETAILED PROJECTION SEMANTICS DEFINED`.

No new cross-Application contract family is required. The existing accepted Web <-> Trading request/projection families remain authoritative:

```text
Web -> Trading:
falcon.xapp.shared.web.trading.core.user-intent

Trading -> Web:
falcon.xapp.trading.core.shared.web.presentation-projection
falcon.xapp.trading.core.shared.web.user-intent-outcome
```

P1K-019 remains the accepted informational query/response boundary where applicable, and FCR-0127 remains the base on-demand analysis request/result contract.

For detailed AI-chat asset analysis, Shared Web SHALL reuse `FSATS.WebOnDemandAnalysisRequest.v1` with a bounded `AnalysisIntent` identifying detailed asset analysis. The returned `FSATS.WebOnDemandAnalysisResult.v1` may carry the following additional Trading-owned projection identity:

`FSATS.WebDetailedAssetAnalysisProjection.v1`

This projection is a semantic view inside the existing response family, not a new route or authority class.

Required projection semantics, when available/applicable:

```text
ResolvedInstrumentIdentity
AnalysisResultId
AsOfTime
OverallTruthState
InputTruthFreshnessSummary

HorizonViews[]
  HorizonId = SHORT | MEDIUM | LONG | other Trading-owned bounded horizon identity
  ResultState
  Conclusion/Summary
  MaterialLevelsOrTargets[]? only when produced by the authoritative analysis
  ConfidenceOrStrength? only when owned/exposed by the source analysis
  Limitations[]
  Evidence/SourceOutputReferences[]

  Conclusion

  AsOfTime

Synthesis
  SynthesisState
  Agreements[]
  Disagreements[]
  UnresolvedConflicts[]

```

Mandatory truth rules:

```text

CUSTOMER_REQUEST != CAPITAL_RESERVATION
CUSTOMER_REQUEST != UNIVERSE_ADMISSION
```

Trading/Application owns selection of applicable authoritative Strategy/School outputs and any synthesis semantics. Shared Web/AI Chat may explain and format the returned projection but SHALL NOT reconstruct Strategy/School logic, manufacture targets/confidence, suppress material disagreement, or upgrade stale/partial/unknown truth.

If Strategy/School outputs disagree materially, the Application result SHALL preserve that disagreement. A combined explanation may describe the conflict and common ground, but it SHALL NOT fabricate a false consensus.

FCR-0126 remains authoritative for chart-overlay rendering after a School/Strategy is selected. FCR-0128 remains authoritative for dynamic catalog/discovery. FCR-0127 remains authoritative for on-demand instrument resolution, serviceability, and the no-universe-side-effect rule.

No runtime route, provider/broker connectivity, Paper/Shadow/Tiny-Live/Live, deployment, capital, order, execution, Part 3, Foundation-write, or Web-write authority is created by this response.
